# Toolbar { #anylumino.Toolbar }

```python
Toolbar(actions=None, *, callbacks=None, width='100%', height='auto')
```

Toolbar of clickable actions that can invoke Python callbacks.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Default   |
|-----------|--------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| actions   | iterable of dict         | Action definitions. Each action should include an ``id`` and ``label``; optional keys such as ``icon``, ``tooltip``, ``disabled``, or ``separator`` are forwarded to the frontend. ``icon`` uses Web Awesome names. ``icon_family``, ``icon_variant``, and ``icon_library`` can be supplied for the same ``wa-icon`` options as native anylumino controls. | `None`    |
| callbacks | dict\[str, callable\]    | Callback map keyed by action id. A callback receives the activated action id.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `None`    |
| width     | int, float, str, or None | Widget width.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `'100%'`  |
| height    | int, float, str, or None | Widget height.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `'auto'`  |
